verbatimParallelsSentence: NOTE: The following inserts are available in the following parallels: 1990 Topps Baseball, 2024 All-Topps Team, 2024's Greatest Hits, Training Ground, Call to the Hall, 2024 First Pitch. Pink (limited, but not serial-numbered, to 600 copies) Blue (serial-numbered to 150 copies) Green (serial-numbered to 99 copies) Gold (serial-numbered to 50 copies) Orange (serial-numbered to 25 copies) Black (serial-numbered to ten) Red (serial-numbered to five) FoilFractor (one-of-one)
rowCount_check: 25 cards x 9 rungs (blank base + Pink + Blue + Green + Gold + Orange + Black + Red + FoilFractor) = 225 rows scraped.

absenceCheck.correctionNote: PR #2433 review (2026-09-26) found this package's FIRST absence pass wrong: it hardcoded printRun=null when computing the id to point-read, for EVERY row, so every numbered parallel rung (Blue/150, Gold/50, ..., FoilFractor/1) was checked at the WRONG id (missing the :num-N segment computeHobbyIqCardId appends whenever printRun is a number) and 404'd unconditionally regardless of the live catalog. The first pass wrongly staged all 25 FoilFractor rows as absent -- they are in fact checklist-present (source=checklistinsider-2026-08-27) at their correct :num-1 id. Re-verified with backend/scripts/verify-absent.cjs, which reads printRun from the CSV row with no null fallback: 50 of 225 rows (the blank base row AND the FoilFractor row for all 25 cards) are checklist-present; the other 175 (Pink/Blue/Green/Gold/Orange/Black/Red x 25) are genuinely absent and are the only rows staged here.
absenceCheck.method: backend/scripts/verify-absent.cjs -- id via computeHobbyIqCardId from backend/dist (printRun read from the CSV row, never hardcoded), point-read against card_catalog with pk=/cardId and the None-partition shape, read-only Cosmos via az webapp config appsettings pipe (never materialized to disk, never echoed).
absenceCheck.note: The verifierOutput above is the run against the FINAL, already-trimmed 175-row CSV (Pink/Blue/Green/Gold/Orange/Black/Red x 25 cards only) -- it confirms 0 present, 175 absent, i.e. every staged row is genuinely absent. The blank base row and the FoilFractor row (50 rows total, both checklist-present, source=baseballcardpedia-ladders-2026-08-29/-09-02 for base and checklistinsider-2026-08-27 for FoilFractor) are excluded from the staged CSV entirely.
absenceCheck.siblingRungTwinCheck: Re-verified directly (sampled CTH-1, CTH-13, CTH-25 at the Blue rung) against every setKey via lib/sibling-rung-twin.cjs's findSiblingRungTwins -- zero twins. CTH- does not collide with any sibling product's numbering.

ownerRuling: CTH- lives under `topps` (no separate key) -- own letter prefix, no clash with plain Series 1/2 base numbering or any other staged product's numbering (confirmed by the zero-twin result above).
